units: Ber. 22ᵃ לְחָשָׁהּ לר׳ וכ׳ said it in a whisper to R. A.—Esp. to whisper an incantation, to charm.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:1">Snh. X, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90a:16">90ᵃ</cite>) <he>הלוֹחֵשׁ על המכה וכ׳</he> he who mumbles over a wound reciting the verse (<cite ref="Exodus 15:26">Ex. XV, 26</cite>) &c. Ib. 101ᵃ <he>לוֹחֲשִׁין לחישת וכ׳</he> you may whisper a charm over bites of serpents and scorpions on the Sabbath; [Rashi: charm serpents &c. to make them innocuous].
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:6">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לוחשין לעין וכ׳</he> you may cure by charm a sore eye &c.; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to whisper, hiss (of the serpent); to inform. Tanḥ. Vaëra 4 (ref. to Ber. V, 1, v. כְּרִיכָה) מה הנחש מְלַחֵשׁ והירג אף המלכות מְלַחֶשֶׁת וכ׳ as the serpent hisses and kills, so does the (Roman) government hiss (inform) and kill; [read:] הוא נותן את האדם בבית האסורין והוא מלחש עליו והורגו the same (officer) puts a man in prison and the same informs against him and puts him to death; Ex. R. s. 9.—Tanḥ. Balak 14 מְלַחֲשִׁין אחריו ברוך שם וכ׳ they (the demons) repeat after him in a low voice, Blessed be the name &c.; Num. R. s. 20; a. e.—Trnsf. to incite, mislead.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7b">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 6b:6">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>ואם לִחֶשְׁךָ אדם לומר וכ׳</he> and if one mislead thee saying &c.; <cite ref="Gittin 23b">Gitt. 23ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:9">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>מי לחשך שהוציא וכ׳</he> who told thee that the Lord discharged the first-born (in disgrace) &c.?—[<cite ref="Eruvin 91a:8">Erub. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>מי לחשך</he>, read <he>הלכה כר״ש</he>, as <cite ref="Eruvin 74a">ib. 74ᵃ</cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90.]

senses.gloss: (with ל) to be hissed at, be incited.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:11:1">Koh. R. to X, 11</cite> <he>אין הנחש … אא״כ נ׳ לו וכ׳</he> no serpent bites unless it is set on from above; <he>ואין המלכות … אא״כ נ׳ לה מלעיל</he> nor does government persecute a man, unless it is set on from above.
